value.signature: fn active_deadlines (& self) -> (Option < u64 > , Option < u64 > , Option < u64 >)

review.body: { let startup = matches ! (self . state , State :: Constructing | State :: Starting | State :: ReadyCheck | State :: Notifying) . then_some (self . startup_deadline) . flatten () ; let stopping = (self . state == State :: Retiring) . then_some (self . stop_deadline) . flatten () ; let drain = (self . state == State :: Retiring && self . work_pending && ! self . work_settled) . then_some (self . drain_deadline) . flatten () ; (startup , stopping , drain) }
review.item_premise: This read-only support operation reports only active supplied-timeline bounds and performs no effect, renewal or private-capability access.
